review_notes: Expectations are draft heuristics written without looking at current results. A reviewer marks each task accepted/edited/dropped before it is used as a gate. required_any matches name, description or tool text (case-insensitive substring) in the top N; empty means no listing should be shown or a suggestion instead.

reviewed.rule: required_any terms must name the task itself; words that also match unrelated listings (market, address, forecast, task, health, space) were narrowed. Compound tasks still pass on any one part; a stricter both-parts check is a later change.
